NAME: Plucky
TEXT: Plucky is a friendly and independent greyhound with a charming personality! She loves spending time in her kennel and lounging on her bed, making her a cozy and content companion. With her plucky attitude, she’s full of confidence and doesn't mind doing her own thing. While she enjoys being around people, she also appreciates her personal space. If you're looking for a laid-back but lovable dog with a bit of spunk, Plucky is the perfect match!

NAME: Flossie
TEXT: Flossie is a lovely fawn greyhound with a playful and friendly personality! She gets along great with all dogs and loves spending time with children. Her favorite thing in the world? Water! Flossie loves to splash around and have fun in the water. She's a sweet and affectionate girl who will bring a lot of joy to any family or home. Playful, kind, and always up for an adventure, Flossie is the perfect companion!

NAME: Ferret
TEXT: Meet Ferret, a friendly and playful greyhound with a heart of gold! She's great with all other dogs and absolutely loves children, making her the perfect family companion. Ferret got her unique name because, as a pup, she would "ferret" her way to steal food from her mum—an adorable trait that stuck! She's gentle, affectionate, and always ready for a fun time. Whether it's running around or cuddling up, Ferret is sure to bring joy to any home!

NAME: King
TEXT: The Kingdom of Paws awaits a noble companion—could it be you? Allow us to introduce King, a noble and regal Greyhound, who is on a grand journey to master the ways of the royal household. As a fresh member of the pet world, he will need a family ready to guide him through the realms of home life. He’s a bright soul with a thirst for learning—are you ready to take the throne as his loyal guide? 🏰 And what’s a King without his treasure? King’s favorite pastime is playing with toys—whether it be a squeaky ball, a tug rope, or anything he can chase, this noble pup knows how to have fun. King has lived with children in the past, and he has proven to be friendly and gentle in their company. While he may be excitable and full of wiggles, he’s also friendly with medium and large dogs. His enthusiasm for life is contagious, and he’s looking for a kingdom (aka a comfy couch) where he can grow, learn, and continue to shine. Ready to crown him your new best friend? Come meet King as our Western Sydney facility today! 👑

NAME: Cilantro
TEXT: Cilantro is a young & sweet boy. His adorable nature & curious enthusiasm makes him a perfect companion for many family types. This bouncy, friendly and wiggly little guy can be curious about the world but his adaptable personality means he'll fit in seamlessly with any loving household. He loves long walkies and playtimes and enjoys having an outlet for his mental stimulation & daily enrichment. He loves treats, toys & loves a little zoomie with a short burst of energy, so would need at least a fully fenced townhouse, or backyard. A few hours alone are no problem with Cilantro as he has shown to cope well in alone time sessions, so if you’re looking for an easy-going & charming boy to complete your family, get in touch with Wester Sydney. Cilantro is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Hunter
TEXT: Hunter, the Backyard Explorer, is Ready for a Peaceful Retreat! 🏕️ Hunter is a confident and easygoing Greyhound with a love for calm, peaceful environments. Having been around children of all ages, Hunter is gentle, friendly, and well-mannered—making him the perfect companion for a family who enjoys a quiet, outdoor lifestyle. He has also lived with many of his Greyhound friends before and shows promising social behavior. After a meet and greet, he would be happy to share his space with other medium to large dogs. Hunter will need some support as he transitions into pet life, but with the right guidance, he’ll thrive in a laid-back home. A backyard is a must for him, where he can relax and enjoy the fresh air after a day of exploring his surroundings. Hunter will thrive in a loving home where he can get plenty of playtime, attention and social support and his perfect family will be one that understands it may take some time before this handsome man truely opens up. If you're looking for a loyal, confident companion who enjoys a quiet lifestyle, leisurely strolls, and moments of relaxation in the sun, Hunter is the perfect fit for your peaceful retreat!

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is the epitome of sweetness, with a heart as soft as her fur. This calm and gentle greyhound is a true people lover, always seeking affection and companionship from her favorite humans. Her calm demeanor makes her an ideal companion for anyone looking for a laid-back, cuddly dog to shower with love. Whether she's lounging on the couch or gently leaning in for some pets, Molly will quickly become your favorite snuggle buddy. Molly gets along great with medium and large dogs and would thrive best in a home where she can have a furry companion of similar size. She’s a gentle soul, and her soft personality makes her an ideal match for families or individuals looking for a low-key but loving companion. If you're ready to welcome a calm, affectionate, and cuddly best friend into your home, Molly is waiting to melt your heart and be your new favorite cuddle buddy!

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Looking for a spicy, high-energy pup to add some heat to your life? With her bold confidence and zest for adventure, Pepper will keep you on your toes and bring endless fun to your days. Whether it’s a brisk walk in the park, a game of fetch, or a playful romp with her doggy friends, Pepper’s always up for action and excitement. Her enthusiasm is contagious, and there’s never a dull moment with this fiery girl around! Pepper is confident, sociable, and loves to have a good time, especially with medium to large dogs who can match her energy. If you're looking for a fun-loving, playful companion to join in your outdoor adventures and keep the excitement rolling, Pepper’s the one for you! She’s the perfect addition to an active home where she can burn off some of that spicy energy and steal your heart with her fiery personality. Ready for a hot new addition to your family? Pepper can’t wait to meet you at the Western Sydney Facility!

NAME: Jetti Spaghetti
TEXT: Meet Jet – the Laid-Back Legend you’ve been waiting for. Looking for a dog who’s got the wisdom of age and the vibe of your chilliest friend? Let us introduce you to Jet – or as we like to call him when he’s zooming for snacks, Jetti Spaghetti :D. At 9 years young, Jet’s perfected the art of balance: he’s still got pep in his step for a good stroll or a playful trot, but he also knows the value of a solid nap (preferably on his beloved bed, thank you very much.) Jet is the definition of easy-going. He gets along with everyone – dogs big and small – and is cool with cats, too. He’s also comfortable being home alone, making him an ideal companion for people who work full time ( but don’t worry – he’ll always be up for a bedtime cuddle). And yes – Jet loves his treats, but he’s not pushy about it. He’s more of a “look at you lovingly until you get the hint” type. He is that dog – the one that fits effortlessly into your life. No drama. No fuss. Just good vibes, waggy tails, and a soft snooze nearby. Come meet Jetti Spaghetti before someone else scoops up this deliciously chill noodle.

NAME: Montana
TEXT: Say hello to adorable and sweet Montana! Not only is she gorgeous with her white and brindle coat, she also has a stunning personality to match. This young and tiny girl would be a great addition any family! She loves people and is known for her super friendly and outgoing nature. Respectful kids would enjoy her fun loving and affectionate nature. Montana also loves other dogs around her size and would be suitable for living with a medium/large size canine brother or sister. She loves having social company and would do best in a home either with people around often or a doggy friend if you work longer hours. Montana seems to love being indoors and is doing well with her stairs training, meaning she could potentially be suitable for unit/apartment living. She loves her treats and is picking up training quickly here at GAP HQ, having already made great progress on her recall, down and shake cues! Montana would love to meet you! So come on down to our Western Sydney kennels to meet this beauty today.

NAME: Pirate
TEXT: Pirate is a lovely girl who gets her name since she has a patch over one of her eyes. She is social and confident, she is also very relaxed and calm. She would suit a life where she could live anywhere as long as she gets out for a walk daily to stay social.

NAME: Fawnie
TEXT: Fawnie is a beautiful sweet hound, she has lived in a rural setting around a variety of different animals, she is great company and is good with kids.

NAME: Sweetie
TEXT: Sweetie is social and content, she has been walked by kids as part of her routine her whole life, she has seen a variety of animals and would suit a quiet life.

NAME: Mary
TEXT: Mary is a great hound, she is familiar with many different animals, great with kids and would suit fulltime workers. She enjoys stretching her legs out and relaxes pretty quickly after a play.

NAME: Simon
TEXT: Simon is a charming hound, he does like to stretch his legs with a morning zoomie and fetching toys. He burns himself almost straight away and enjoys being a lazy hound. He is a good mix of being an active hound that likes to relax also.

NAME: Joy
TEXT: Joy is a lovely girl. She is very sweet and affectionate, she plays with toys and comes when called. She has lived around farm animals and has had visits from native animals on her semi rural property.

NAME: Maddie
TEXT: This stunning girl is very playful and polite. She is a confident young hound who is very social and lovely to be around.

NAME: Dusty
TEXT: Howdy, partner! Name’s Dusty, and I’m a handsome greyhound lookin’ to saddle up and make some memories with ya! 🤠 I’m a social cowboy, friendly with folks and always up for a good ol’ chinwag. I get along great with medium and large dogs, and with a bit of further training and a meet-and-greet, I could be rustlin' up some friendships with smaller breeds too! 🐾 Now, I’m not one to turn down a good meal — I’m mighty food motivated! If you’ve got some tasty treats or a fun toy in your pocket, I’ll be the best partner-in-crime you could ask for! 🍖🎾 I’m also used to my crate, so I know when it’s time to rest in my own little space, but I’ll be rarin' to go when you’re ready for some fun! If you’re lookin' for a loyal, friendly companion with a heart as big as the Wild West, I’d be thrilled to join your posse. Let’s make this ride a whole lot more fun, partner! 🤠🌵

NAME: Sammy Sunshine
TEXT: I'm Sammy Sunshine, and I'm here to brighten your day and steal your heart! 🌞 I'm a gorgeous greyhound, and if you're looking for a friend who's sweet, friendly, and always up for an adventure, then you’ve come to the right place! I absolutely love car rides — whether it’s a quick trip to the park or a longer road trip, I’m always ready to hop in and go wherever the journey takes us. 🚗💨 I get along fabulously with medium and large dogs — I'm friendly and social, and I love making new pals to run around and play with. And guess what? I grew up around young children, so I’m totally comfortable with little humans too! Whether you're looking for a companion for your family or a furry best friend to enjoy quiet moments with, I’m your girl! 💖 When it comes to walks, I'm the perfect leash walker. No pulling, no tugging — I walk beautifully right by your side, just like a pro! 🐾 I have a big heart full of love, and I can’t wait to share it with you 🌸 If you're ready for a loyal companion with a sunny personality who will fill your life with joy, I’m just waiting for you to take me home. Can’t wait to meet you and bring a little sunshine into your world! 🌈✨

NAME: Brindie
TEXT: This affectionate & gentle girl is Brindie. She is great with training cues here at the centre including recall, down, off and shake. She enjoys being social with other greyhounds at the centre and would happily share her new home with one. If you're after a joyful companion, she is right up there. Brindie is polite and respectful on lead, she is sociable with people & would love to go to her new home that has a nice backyard/townhouse for her to enjoy. She has been enjoying the indoors here and can even walk up and down stairs, so she would be suitable to live in a unit apartment setting. Brindie would do best in a low small dog populated area and an owner eager to work on her manners around smaller breeds. This little cutie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ripple
TEXT: Ripple is the playful pup who's ready to dive into your life with all the fun and joy you could ask for! This happy guy loves toys and ear scratches - he will even give you a "paw-of more" when you hit the right spot! Whether he’s fetching toys, swimming through playtime, or splashing around with his humans, Ripple brings a tidal wave of affection and energy wherever he goes. Ripple’s social nature makes him a great buddy for medium to large dog friends (pending a meet-and-greet), and he’ll happily "surf" through life with a solid confidence on stairs. He’s a big fan of indoor lounging too, and is ready to build up to longer hours at home alone as he gets more comfortable. If you're looking for a dog who’s ready to make waves in your heart, with a splash of fun and endless affection, Ripple is the perfect catch. Get ready for the joy and excitement of having this playful pup ride the current into your life!

NAME: Maximo
TEXT: Maximo is a sporty and fun-loving greyhound with a passion for water and a heart full of love. Whether he’s splashing around in the pool or running around with his greyhound buddies, he’s always up for an active, fun time. Maximo is also fantastic with kids, having spent time with young ones and showing nothing but patience and gentleness. His easy-going nature and friendly demeanor make him a perfect fit for a family looking for a loving, playful companion. Maximo is also open to living with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and has the potential to coexist with small dogs and cats with the right training and introductions, and pending a meet and greet. His calm and cooperative attitude will make him a great addition to your home. If you’re looking for a sporty, fun, and affectionate dog who’s ready to join your team, Maximo could be the perfect match! Come meet him and see why he’s ready to take your home to the next level!

NAME: Riot
TEXT: Meet Riot, the epitome of easygoing! With a name that speaks to his spirit, Riot is ready to fill your days with joy and companionship. His gentle nature and playful antics make him an ideal addition to any home looking for a devoted friend. Riot has an amazing disposition that makes him friendly to people and pets alike. He'll fit into almost any living situation that keeps him active and allows him time for fun and an outdoor activities. He has been around kids 10+ and has proved to be a lovely, affectionate boy around all he meets. Riot is available at Western Sydney's adoption centre.

NAME: Inky
TEXT: Inky is like a beautiful work of art—timid at first, but with patience and care, he’ll gradually reveal the loving, loyal companion he’s meant to be. His quiet, gentle nature makes him a calm and serene presence in any home, though he does take time to adjust to new environments. Once he feels comfortable, Inky’s true personality will shine through, and you’ll discover just how sweet and affectionate he really is. While he may be shy in new environments, he walks beautifully on the lead and exudes a quiet, graceful presence. With some further training in his new home, Inky has the potential to live with cats and small dogs, as he showed little interest with them here at site. Like any great work of art, he requires a gentle hand and a little guidance, but with the right care, he’ll become the masterpiece you’ve been waiting for. Like an abstract piece of art, Inky has the potential to fit into a variety of homes with the right guidance, are you the right fit for this stunning boy? Chat with the Western Sydney team to find out!

NAME: Nyx
TEXT: Like the goddess Nyx, I am a gentle and mysterious spirit, a little timid in new surroundings but full of potential once I find my place. With patience and time, I’ll reveal my true, loving nature. I may need a calm and quiet environment to adjust, but I promise that when I do, you’ll see the sweetness and loyalty I have to offer. I have potential live with cats and small dogs with some further training, as I showed minimal interest in them onsite. I’m looking for a family who can help me bloom into the confident companion I’m meant to be. I tend to find my person and stick with them, so if you’re patient and understanding, together we can create a bond as strong and lasting as the night itself. 🌙

NAME: Ruby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Ruby, I'm pretty and petite like my gemstone name. I have a placid & quiet nature. I’m a sweet middle aged hound looking for a family who will love me forever. I would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to enjoy indoor outdoor living. I am a perfect addition if you're looking for a loving companion. I would like a home with calm kids and calm dogs so I can enjoy the quiet life with you. Like all greyhounds, I do have a little burst of energy and will zoom around and play with my toys, but don’t worry as soon as I’m finished you will find me in bed or laying in the sun. If you think this I could be suited to your home then apply to meet me today at our Londonderry site.

NAME: Morgan
TEXT: Looking for a dog who’s got the perfect mix of confidence, playfulness, and pure good vibes? Morgan is affectionate & dog social, who we think would be perfect for so many homes. He is agile, smart, and eager to learn, making training fun and rewarding. He even tried some agility for fun and totally rocked it. He's just as happy lounging at home as he is exploring the world. He’s got that easy-going charm – friendly with all dogs, super chill when left alone, and always up for a good time. He would be best with older children as he has a streak of excitement. Morgan is that greyhound who greets every day with excitement, whether it’s a walk, play time, or just a lazy afternoon soaking up the sun. He has enjoyed settling in our crate and enjoys engagement & training activities. If you’re looking for a dog who’s relaxed but always ready for an adventure, social but independent, and just an all-around legend of a companion, Morgan’s your guy. He is available at our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Indigo
TEXT: Hi, I'm Indigo! I'm a young curious girl so I'd love to grow up with a family who has a townhouse or backyard for me to do my goofy zoomies in. I would happily live with older kids with some dog experience, too! An owner who enjoys ongoing training and who would like to keep showing me the world would be so amazing as I have loved learning new tricks and getting out in the hustle and bustle with my handler. I'd prefer my home without any other pets in it, however I'm friendly with dogs on walks including those smaller dogs I keep seeing around! My perfect home would be short hours alone to begin with so they can spend all their time doting on me and telling me how cute and adorable I am but I have shown I don't fuss or stir when people leave me alone. Finally...I can't let you go without telling you the tricks I know - I'm learning my name means something, so does the word 'yes' and I've even got my stair licence! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Noah
TEXT: Meet Noah – A Shy and Sweet Greyhound! Noah is a quiet and gentle male greyhound who may take a little time to warm up, but once he feels comfortable, he’s a loyal and loving companion. He’s a bit shy at first, so patience is key when getting to know him. Noah is great with small dogs and enjoys their company. His calm nature makes him a perfect fit for a peaceful home where he can feel safe and secure. If you’re looking for a quiet, sweet dog who will take time to build trust, Noah might just be the perfect companion for you!

NAME: Taylor
TEXT: Meet Taylor (aka Book Book) – A Sweet and Shy Greyhound! Taylor, also known as Book Book, is a lovely female greyhound with a gentle, shy personality. She might take a little time to warm up, but once she feels comfortable, she’s a sweet and loving companion. Taylor is great with small dogs, and her calm and quiet nature makes her a wonderful addition to any home. She’s also very clean, always keeping her space tidy and neat. If you’re looking for a sweet, quiet, and clean companion who will slowly but surely open up to you, Taylor is the perfect fit!

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Chandler is a beautiful fawn greyhound with a confident and friendly personality. She’s easygoing and loves making new friends, especially small dogs, with whom she’s always gentle and kind. Not only is she great with other pups, but Chandler is also a pro at stairs, making her a perfect fit for any home, no matter the layout. Her sweet, calm nature will bring joy to your family, and she’s always ready for a little playtime or snuggle session. If you are a fan of FRIENDS you will understand why they have named a gorgeous girl Chandler!!!!! If you're looking for a loving, confident dog to join your family, Chandler is the one!

NAME: Shania
TEXT: Just like the iconic country singer, Shania knows how to steal the spotlight and leave a lasting impression. This sweet girl is ready to " Feel Like a Woman!"—and that woman is looking for a loving home where she can enjoy all the cuddles and attention she deserves. Shania is incredibly social with humans and loves nothing more than cuddles and affection. She’ll be your best friend in no time! Plus, she’s shown potential with cats and small dogs. As Shania is only new to GAP her new family will need to continue this work in her furever home and before long she will harmonize with your other pets – pending a doggie meet and greet of course! Whether you’re cozying up on the couch or going for a leisurely stroll, Shania’s your girl, always ready to give you all that love. So, if you’re looking for a sweet, snuggly companion to bring joy into your life, look no further—Shania’s here to stay, and she’s ready to "Come On Over"!

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Looking for a fun-loving, people-obsessed companion? Sam the greyhound is your guy! 🐾 With his playful personality and endless enthusiasm, he’s ready to steal your heart and bring joy to every adventure. Sam is a total people pleaser, always eager for his human's attention and affection. He’s incredibly social and loves to be around his people, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a friendly, outgoing dog. Sam is also pro when it comes to car rides—he loves hopping in for a fun adventure and travels like a champ. Whether it’s exploring new environments or playing with his favorite toys, Sam is always up for the next exciting thing! He’s also a big fan of walks, where his playful, excitable personality shines. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and energetic pup to share your life with, Sam is your guy! 🐕💙 Contact the Western Sydney team to meet Sam today!

NAME: Bubba & Lola
TEXT: Bubba (5 years old) and Lola (3 years old) are a bonded pair of very sweet girls currently living together in a home. Bubba is the more outgoing of the two, while Lola has a softer, gentler nature. Both are great with smaller dogs, and with the correct introduction, they may be okay with cats. They are searching for a new home where they can stay together and continue to thrive as a loving, playful duo.

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Jayne is a very smoochy and cuddly dog with a kind, sweet-natured personality. She’s highly affectionate and loves socializing with people. Confident and loving, she’d thrive in a home where she can receive plenty of attention. With the correct introduction, she might be okay with smaller dogs and cats, making her a great companion for a variety of households.

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a playful, cheeky, and energetic female greyhound who loves people and is very social. She’s curious and full of fun, always ready for an adventure. With the right introduction, she might get along with smaller dogs, making her a great addition to an active and engaging home.

NAME: Collie
TEXT: Collie is a sweet older female with a calm, relaxed, and easy-going nature. She’s happy to please and would thrive in a slower-paced home. Older children are best for her, and she’s fine with smaller dogs and cats, making her a wonderful companion for a peaceful and loving household.

NAME: Hector
TEXT: Hector is a young and cute dog with a playful and cheeky personality. He’s full of energy and will grow in maturity once he settles into his new home. Hector would thrive in a playful family environment, where he can have fun and enjoy lots of toys. He’s also fine with smaller dogs, making him a great addition to a lively household.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Billy is a sweet, affectionate, and kind natured boy. He’s loving and enjoys playing with toys, often collecting them on his bed. Billy is interactive and gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs, making him a fun and friendly companion.

NAME: Dare
TEXT: Dare is a big, gentle giant with a very sweet and playful nature. He’s fun-loving yet shows a patient and calm side when needed. Confident and happy, Dare is the perfect mix of energy and tranquility, making him an affectionate companion for any home.

NAME: Windy
TEXT: Windy is a very sweet-natured male dog who can be a little shy at first but quickly comes out of his shell, especially when playing with toys. Confident on his own, he gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is sure to bring joy and warmth once he settles in.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a calm, easy-going, and very friendly dog with an affectionate and interactive nature. He loves to connect with others and is great with smaller breeds of dogs. Hank’s gentle personality makes him a wonderful companion for any home looking for a sweet and sociable pet.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a happy boy who thrives on his own in a single-dog household. He needs a supportive home where he can grow and learn. With patience and encouragement, Tom will blossom into a loving and confident companion.

NAME: April
TEXT: April is a pretty girl who is eager to learn and grow. She needs encouragement, patience, and lots of love to thrive. A quieter home would be perfect for her, where she can feel safe and supported as she blossoms into a confident companion.

NAME: Scotch
TEXT: Scotch is a happy, confident male greyhound who enjoys a slower-paced home due to a leg injury. While he may take shorter walks, he’s still able to move around and play just fine. Engaging and full of joy, Scotch is a loving companion who thrives in a calm environment.

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Uno is a lovely older female greyhound with an engaging and confident personality. She’s sweet, kind, and always happy, bringing a joyful and warm presence to any home. Uno’s calm nature and affectionate demeanor make her the perfect companion for a loving family.

NAME: Dozer
TEXT: Dozer, or "Little D," is a sweet boy who needs time and patience to learn and grow. He’ll thrive in a quiet home where he can feel safe and supported as he blossoms into his best self. With the right care, he’s sure to become a loving companion.

NAME: Milo
TEXT: Milo is a fun-loving male greyhound with a playful and confident personality. He’s happy, sweet-natured, and kind, making him a loving companion for any home. Milo’s cheerful attitude and affectionate nature are sure to bring joy to those around him.

NAME: Lexi
TEXT: Lexi is a sweet and placid female greyhound with a calm demeanor. Eager to learn, she needs room to grow and thrive, along with patience and understanding. A single-dog household would be ideal, providing her with the space and care she needs to flourish.

NAME: Aggi
TEXT: Aggi is a pretty female greyhound who can be a little shy at first. She needs encouragement, support, love, and time to grow. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel secure and receive the attention she needs. Aggi is eager to learn and thrive with the right care and patience.

NAME: Micha
TEXT: Micha is a sweet female greyhound who needs love, support, and encouragement to grow. Eager to learn, she’ll thrive in a quiet home where she can feel safe and secure. A single-dog household is ideal at first, giving her the space and attention she needs to adjust and build confidence.

NAME: Tubby
TEXT: Tubby is a sweet girl who can be a little unsure at times, but with the right support, she will thrive. She needs time, patience, and encouragement to fully blossom. A single-dog household is ideal for her, where she can feel safe and receive the love she needs to build confidence.

NAME: Sassy
TEXT: Sassy is a female greyhound looking for a quiet, supportive, and loving home. She needs room to grow, learn, and thrive, along with the encouragement and patience to help her blossom. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can receive all the attention and care she deserves.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a sweet female greyhound who can be a little shy and unsure at first, but she’ll open up with time and patience. She needs space, encouragement, and room to grow in a supportive environment. Molly thrives in a single-dog household where she can receive the love and attention she needs to feel comfortable and secure.

NAME: Minni
TEXT: Minni is a laid-back, easy-going older gal with a calm and confident demeanor. She’s curious and independent, but also affectionate and loves a good snuggle. Minni is the perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed and loving pet.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Lucy is a very friendly and affectionate older girl who loves to give and receive cuddles. She can be relaxed and easy-going, but also has a cheeky, playful side that adds fun to her personality. Good with smaller breeds of dogs, Lucy makes a sweet and loving companion for any home.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Cindy is a beautiful female greyhound who needs a supportive, patient family to help her grow. She thrives with encouragement and would do best in a quiet home to start. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel safe and secure as she adjusts and blossoms.

NAME: Oscar
TEXT: Oscar is a very happy and friendly dog with an excitable personality. He’s great around other breeds of dogs and gets along well with small children. With a funny character and a unique way of bucking like a horse, Oscar is sure to bring lots of joy and laughter to any home.

NAME: Banj
TEXT: Banj is a sweet, older female greyhound, ready to enjoy a relaxing retirement. She’s calm, easy-going, and laid-back, thriving in a peaceful home. Banj gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is comfortable around older children, making her the perfect companion for a quiet, loving household.

NAME: Snoz
TEXT: Snoz is a male greyhound with a calm and quiet demeanor. He’s patient, easy-going, and always happy, enjoying a laid-back lifestyle. With his gentle nature, he’s the perfect companion for anyone seeking a relaxed and peaceful pet.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Bella, a sweet, kind, and patient female greyhound who remains calm in new environments. She’s excited to play and learn, always eager for new experiences. Bella is affectionate and loves to spend time with her humans, and she gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs. She’s ready to bring her gentle spirit and enthusiasm for life to a loving home!

NAME: Nova
TEXT: Meet Nova, a beautiful and sweet female greyhound who will melt your heart once she settles into her new home. She’s affectionate and loves cuddles, and she has a playful side when it comes to toys! Nova is patient and eager to learn, making her a wonderful companion for a family who can help her continue to grow. She’s ready to share her love and brighten your life!

NAME: Flyer
TEXT: Meet Flyer, a goofy, playful, and affectionate male greyhound who loves nothing more than a good cuddle! He’s sooky and cuddly, always ready for some snuggles, and has a great time playing with toys and running in the yard. Flyer would love a family with children to play fetch with and enjoys being active outdoors. He’s been around smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks, and sheep, so he’s well-mannered around other animals. Flyer’s ready to fill your home with love and fun!

NAME: Cara
TEXT: This affectionate young hound is great with kids, good with all dogs and stays in her own lane. She is a quite non-confrontational girl who would suit most people as a life long companion.

NAME: Shara
TEXT: Shara is a stunning Blue Brindle hound. She has been living around young kids and has visits and runs around with little dogs.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a confident friendly boy who is great company. He loves to play, loves affection and walks well on the lead. Benji would suit a working household since he is content when left alone.

NAME: Blue
TEXT: Meet Blue, a fun-loving, high-energy male greyhound with a great spirit! He’s playful and full of personality, always ready for a game of fetch or a run around the yard. Blue would thrive in a home with a yard to stretch his legs and children to play with. He’s been around smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks, and even sheep, so he’s adaptable and gets along with a variety of animals. Blue is ready to bring his boundless energy and joy to a loving home!

NAME: Bec
TEXT: Meet Bec, a playful and affectionate female greyhound who absolutely loves toys! She enjoys collecting and playing with them, and there's nothing better than a cuddle and some quality time with her humans. Bec thrives in a home with an experienced owner who can provide her with the care and attention she needs, including a backyard to run and explore. She’s grown up around children, but older kids are best for her. She’s ready to bring love and joy into a forever home!

NAME: Zac
TEXT: Meet this gentle and shy male greyhound, looking for a loving, supportive family to help him continue to grow and thrive. With a quiet nature, he enjoys the simple pleasures of life, like collecting little toys, and he responds beautifully to a gentle touch. Having grown up around small children, he’s well-suited for a family environment. An experienced dog owner would be ideal, as he’s looking for someone who can provide the patience and care he needs to flourish.

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: I'm Lilly, and my humans have called me a sweet, loving greyhound, but I really just want to find a family to love me. At first, I might be a little shy and scared, but if you’re patient and show me lots of love, I promise I’ll trust you and be your best friend! I’ve met little dogs, cats, and even chickens, but they’re kinda scary to me. I’m much more comfy with other greyhounds though, I really like them! I'd be happy to meet your calm small dog and see if we get along as well though. I loooove my soft toys, especially the ones with squeakers! They’re so much fun, and I can play with them for a long time. I can be a little bit of a sook sometimes, but that’s just because I’m so sweet and I love people a lot. I just need a little time to feel safe, and then I’ll be all cuddles and love for you! If you take me home, I’ll show you how much I love you, and we can be best friends forever!

NAME: Bell
TEXT: Hi there! My name is Bell, and I’m really hoping to find a family that will love me. At first, I might be a little shy because everything is so new, but once I feel safe and cozy, I’ll be the sweetest, cuddliest friend you could ever ask for! I’ve been around little kids, like the ones who are 1 to 7, and I’m so calm and gentle with them. I really like them a lot! If you take me home, I’ll snuggle up close and be your best friend. I might need a little time to settle in, but I promise I’ll be the most loving, loyal companion. Oh, and it would be so wonderful if I had a medium or large doggy friend to play with! I think we could have so much fun together. I might be a bit shy at first, but I’m really sweet and just want to be loved. If you give me the chance, I’ll show you all the love in my heart, and we’ll be the best of friends forever!

NAME: Trixie
TEXT: Ready for a new adventure? I’m Trixie, a playful and curious greyhound with a love for exploring! I’m confident in new places and always eager to see what’s next. Water is one of my favorite things — dams, pools, fountains and even my bath time! I don't care as long as there is water, I can splash around! I get along well with other doggies, and I’ve even been around chickens before (but I’m still figuring them out). If you have a smaller breed of pup at home , or any other pups at home really, I would love to have a meeting to see if we get along! If you’re looking for a sweet, energetic companion who’s always ready to have fun, I just might be the one for you!

NAME: Mary
TEXT: Meet Mary, a beautiful, gentle, and sweet-natured senior girl who is a true gem. She may have years behind her, but she’s still looking fabulous and enjoys her weekly walk on the main street with the 8-year-old daughter. She absolutely adores attention and affection from the kids, 8 and 16-year-olds, who give her pats and cuddles. She’s unfazed by other dogs during her walks and is perfectly content to relax in the yard, soaking up the serenity. She doesn't like storms and won't eat until the morning but doesn't panic, just goes to her bed in her kennel outside or inside as her safe place. Mary would be the perfect addition to a quiet family household with older kids or can share her love with retirees and busy workers looking for a calm and loving companion. Anyone would be lucky to have her, and she would show you her special mane or mohawk on the back of her neck - it's so cute!

NAME: Tony
TEXT: Tony is a barrel full of laughs, love & fun! This big goof ball loves to run, play & chase. He is an active boy with a spirit to match! He would love to find a home with older active children he can run around with in the backyard. Potentially another grey or large breed of dog to play with as well. He is a confident boy who doesn't shy away from much. Tony is ready to find his perfect family! Reach out to meet him today!

NAME: Doris
TEXT: Doris is enjoying a foster care home in a ground floor unit while she awaits her forever family. At 12 years young, Doris enjoys the finer things in life & is proving to still have a spring in her step! From foster care: Doris is a delightful senior greyhound with a heart as big as her love for cuddles! This sweet, silly girl is happiest when she’s right by your side—whether that’s following you from room to room, leaning in for pats, or curling up next to you. She’s playful, affectionate, and always ready for a walk. If you’re looking for a devoted companion who will make you laugh, keep you company, and shower you with love, Doris is your girl. Doris LOVES her walks and takes her foster carers out to enjoy a walk every day. She also has shown her foster family she is learning her name, and walks nicely on the lead. She enjoys snuggling up on the couch, and at the GAP centre she enjoyed being social with other greyhounds, proving her adaptable nature. Doris is finally ready to step paws into a forever home - could it be with you? Maybe you have a laid back hound looking for a friend or simply looking for a sweet senior to spoil rotten ... Doris is in foster care and available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's, even your feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Sweet Missy is a darling girl looking for her perfect family. Missy is looking for love & support from her new family in order for her shine and grow into the best version of herself. A quiet & patient home would be best. With growth, she will shine in personality & playfulness. Missy responds well to young children. She has spent time living indoors with a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction, Missy might become best friends with your small pups or feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet her :)

NAME: Wichita
TEXT: Wichita is gorgeous, sweet girl, pretty chill but does get excited when running around with her other greymates! She absolutely loves water, a clam shell pool, which would keep her occupied as well as toys and is much quiter with the company of an older small dog as a companion but would also be happy as an only dog. She has such a loving nature, loves attention and pats, is well handled and good on lead. Better with older children, hasn't been around little ones. Wichi would make a lovely companion and walking buddy for couples, families with older kids and retirees, also happy to keep herself occupied for workers.

NAME: Jumbo
TEXT: Jumbo may have a giant name, but he's all lean speed and excitement! This sleek black greyhound is full of energy and enthusiasm, always ready to take on new adventures. He can be a little nervous at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up and show his affectionate side. Once comfortable, he enjoys exploring his surroundings with a good sniff and settles in beautifully, just pure relaxation. With his lively spirit and charming nature, Jumbo is sure to make a big impression wherever he goes!

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Betty may be small in size, but she has a big heart! This lovely black greyhound is clean, quiet, and well-mannered, making her a wonderful companion. She gets along great with Boxers and other larger dogs, enjoying their company and playful energy. She’s good with kids and would be best suited to a home with children over five, as she can get a little excited at times. While she’s naturally quiet, once she comes out of her shell and feels comfortable, she shows her incredibly sweet and affectionate side. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving, and easy-going greyhound, Betty is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Amy
TEXT: Meet Amy, a beautifully brindle greyhound with a quiet charm and a heart full of love. She may be a little shy at first, but once she warms up, she’s as sweet as they come. With a bit of patience and kindness, Amy’s gentle personality truly shines. She adores her walks, taking in the world with curious eyes and a graceful stride. Whether it's a peaceful stroll or an exciting adventure, she’s always up for exploring by your side. One of her favourite things? Water! On warm days, Amy loves to cool off with a splash, whether it's wading in a stream or dipping her paws in a puddle. With a soft heart and a love for the simple joys in life, Amy is the perfect companion for someone who appreciates the beauty of a slow and steady friendship.

NAME: Bluey
TEXT: Bluey is a stunning brindle boy who’s been in a home for two years. A little nervous at first, he bonds deeply once he trusts you. He prefers gentle, soft-natured male companions and thrives in a calm environment. He gets excited around food and balls, enjoys treats, and can be hand-fed, though he does resource guard from other dogs. Sensitive to loud noises, he needs reassurance in new situations. Bluey is great friends with a few greys here, and they wouldn't mind sharing his new home. Could you be the one to give Bluey his perfect home?

NAME: Roxy
TEXT: Roxy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. Nothing much phases this laid-back girl—she takes life in stride with an easygoing attitude. She’s a dream to walk on the lead, making her a pleasure to take out and about. Roxy is also fantastic with small dogs and other greyhounds, making her a great fit for a multi-dog household. If you’re looking for a relaxed, friendly companion who’s happy to go with the flow, Roxy is the perfect match!

NAME: Jumbo
TEXT: Jumbo has a fantastic energy! This big goof ball loves to run, play & explore! He would love to find a family with older children who can keep up :) Running around & playing in the backyard with his new best friends would suit him to a Tee! Jumbo has grown up around smaller breeds of dogs and he has had exposure to sheep, chicken & ducks. If you would like to meet Jumbo, please reach out :)

NAME: Dash
TEXT: Dash is a gentle and calm boy who is looking for a laid back home to snooze in. Dash is friendly with smaller dogs & cats here at the adoption centre (see photos!). Dash would enjoy a home with a small yard/courtyard for some place to retreat to during the day. Dash can be reserved and shy in new situations however grows in confidence around other dogs (check out how he mastered the stairs with our small dogs!). Dash truly is a wise gentleman awaiting his perfect family. If you think you have the perfect home for Dash - reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is as handsome and adorable as they come, he is super cute, placid, gentle, charming and engaging with people. Alf is a calm and gentle boy with little bursts of energy. He is a gentle boy & we think he'd suit a home with respectful children. He's used to having yard access so a home with a courtyard/townhouse would suit this placid laid back fellow. He has shown potential to settle in crate but not a requirement. Alf is available from our Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Groot
TEXT: Groot is a male greyhound with a heart full of love! He’s affectionate, quiet, and loves nothing more than being by your side. Groot is a very friendly dog who enjoys spending time with his people, whether it’s cuddling on the couch or simply relaxing together. Groot loves to laze in the house with his family. Why You’ll Love Groot: Affectionate & Loving: Groot is a big cuddle buddy who enjoys being close to you. Quiet & Calm: He’s a peaceful companion, happy to relax and enjoy quiet moments. Very Friendly: Groot loves meeting new people and is always ready to make new friends! If you're looking for a loving and friendly greyhound who just wants to be with you, Groot is the perfect companion! 💕

NAME: Clancy
TEXT: Clancy is a very sweet and lovely 3 1/2-year-old female greyhound. She’s polite with other dogs abut would be happy to have her home to herself. Clancy enjoys spending her time inside, relaxing on her mat, and soaking up all the love she can get. Why You'll Love Clancy: Sweet & Affectionate: Clancy is gentle, loving, and always ready for a cuddle. Polite with Other Dogs: She’s well-mannered and respectful around other dogs. Loves Indoor Relaxation: Clancy enjoys her cozy spot on the mat, making her a calm and easygoing companion. If you’re looking for a kind and calm greyhound to share your home, Clancy would be a perfect fit! 💕

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus may be 9 years old, but don’t let her age fool you – she certainly doesn’t act like it! This sweet, friendly girl is full of energy and loves being around people. She has the heart of a young pup and enjoys every moment spent with her humans. Venus is the perfect mix of a calm, affectionate companion and a fun-loving friend. Why You'll Love Venus: Friendly & People-Loving: Venus absolutely adores people and will be your best friend in no time. Young At Heart: Despite being 9 years old, Venus has the playful energy and spirit of a much younger dog! Calm & Affectionate: She loves cuddles and enjoys relaxing with you, but also has plenty of energy for playtime. If you’re looking for a loving, friendly greyhound who doesn’t act her age, Venus is the one for you! 💕

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Jett is a fun-loving and friendly female greyhound with a playful spirit and an easy-going personality. Born on April 3, 2022, she’s still young and full of energy but knows how to relax and enjoy quiet moments too. Jett’s happy, affectionate nature makes her a great companion for active families or anyone who enjoys a friendly, outgoing dog. Why You'll Love Jett: Playful & Friendly: Jett loves to have fun and is always ready to make new friends, whether it’s with humans or other dogs. Easy-Going: While playful, Jett is also calm and relaxed when it's time to chill. Good with Small Dogs: After a proper introduction, Jett gets along well with small dogs, making her a great addition to a multi-dog home. Young & Energetic: At just 2 years old, Jett has plenty of energy to enjoy walks, playtime, and adventures. Whilst being energetic Jett can be extremely lazy and would be happy to just laze around after a short walk. If you’re looking for a sweet, friendly greyhound with a playful personality, Jett might be your perfect match! 💕

NAME: Cammi
TEXT: At just 23kg, this TINY, and super bubbly playful girl simply just LOVES everyone! She will hop and bounce around, even play bowing at you, while smooshing her tiny face into you to get pats...how could you say no!? She walks nicely on the lead, even going up and down our training stair case. Due to her bubbly & exuberant nature, older children/teens would suit her best. She is friendly with other greyhounds and would suit a home with another large breed dog. Shorter hours left alone while she first settles in will help her find her feet and learn her routine the best. She enjoys being indoors and could suit an apartment home, too. Cammi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cooper
TEXT: Meet Cooper! This friendly boy is looking for a loving home where he can live his best life. Cooper absolutely loves his toys and walks, making him the perfect fit for an active lifestyle. Cooper is social with other medium/large dogs, and has had a great time playing with other greyhounds on site. He would thrive in a home with a playful dog companion, especially if his new family is out of the house more often. Otherwise, if going into a home without a furry companion then Cooper would do best if his people were around more often at first to help him settle in! While Cooper is fantastic indoors, he would be happiest with a backyard available so he can have a blast tossing toys around and lazing about in the sun! With his big personality Cooper would do best in a home without young children. Come meet Cooper at our Londonderry facility and see just how sweet and fun he really is!

NAME: Harvey
TEXT: Meet the sweetest senior boy, Harvey! Harvey absolutely LOVES his treats and has an excitable yet gentle personality! He enjoys a good neck scratch as he discovers the joys of being loved and can't wait to find a family to call his own. This adorable boy is looking for a peaceful home where he can unwind and enjoy the slow life! He’s been good with other medium/large dogs and would do best in a home with a small yard or courtyard, where he can get outside to enjoy the fresh air and snooze in the warmth of the sun. Because of his age, he’d be happiest in a home with no stairs and receiving minimal walks. Whether his new family are full time workers or around more often - This low maintenance guy will be happy either way! If you're looking to give a sweet senior a calm and loving space, Harvey is ready to find his forever home now at our Londonderry centre!

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. He is relaxed on lead, great to handle. Red has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. At times Red can be apprehensive with new people but warms up quickly after he has a good play. Red will be attending the ACT Adoption Day on March 22nd.

NAME: Dutch
TEXT: Dutch is a sweet sensitive hound, he may be a bit shy and quirky at first but he does warm up and is very gentle and affectionate. He is a handsome boy who is calm and laid back. Relaxes well on his own.

NAME: Fenoli
TEXT: Fenoli is strapping young lad, he is calm and content, walks great on the lead and is great company. He is good with kids and relaxes when left alone.

NAME: Kit
TEXT: Kit is a beautiful, friendly male greyhound who loves to be part of the action! With his sleek coat and sweet personality, he’s sure to steal your heart. Kit enjoys being involved in family activities and is always up for fun and playtime. Kit is an affectionate and social dog who loves spending time with people and other dogs. He’s friendly, easy-going, and enjoys being part of the family. Kit is also great with children, making him the perfect companion for a family home. Whether he’s relaxing by your side or participating in family activities, Kit will always be there with a wagging tail.

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Stanley! 🐾 Stanley is a handsome 3-year-old brindle boy with a lovely temperament. He travels well and is always up for an adventure, whether it’s a walk around the lake or a playful run in the backyard. Having lived inside a home, Stanley is well-mannered and crate trained, making him an easy addition to any family. He’s a sweet and adaptable companion looking for a loving place to call home. 📍 Available for adoption now!

NAME: Jindy
TEXT: Jindy is a beautiful 3 year old female who was never interested in chasing things. Jindy is a beautiful family pet and is great with children Jindy enjoys a walk and play during the day but is very used to being alone for full time working hours. Jindy is crate trained and would be a great addition to your way of life as she is very adaptable Jindy is currently living with a family of four and is keen to meet her forever family

NAME: Wheels
TEXT: Hello there! My name is Wheels, and I’m a charming 3-year-old Greyhound looking for my forever home. I might be a little shy at first, but don’t let that fool you! With a bit of patience and love, I’ll warm up to you quickly and show you my gentle, affectionate side. I’m an easygoing guy who enjoys the simple pleasures in life, like lounging in a cozy spot and soaking up the sun. I get along wonderfully with other dogs, and I love having furry friends around me. If you're looking for a loyal companion who will bring joy and a calm presence to your home, I could be the perfect match for you. Let’s embark on this journey together and make wonderful memories! Are you ready to give me the loving home I’ve been waiting for? 🐶❤️

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, friendly girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and quiet kids 10+, not too rambunctious. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has grown up on the farm and has come into town life ready for her new home. She has taken to a nice cosy bed on the floor and loves being on the patio as well on the warm nights. She would suit a quiet household, and someone with the time to get to know her, take her for a walk and have a bit of playtime in the morning, especially if you are going off to work. Some toys, an outdoor bed, pool, sandpit or another dog friend will keep her company for the day, plus plenty of rests. Someone home more often than not would be perfect. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds, cats or little fluffy dogs. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life. 💗

NAME: Lillie
TEXT: Lillie is a sweet and gentle greyhound with a calm and loving nature. She can be a little shy at first, but once she feels comfortable, she’s a loyal and affectionate companion. Lillie is particularly drawn to men and forms strong bonds with them quickly. One of Lillie’s favorite things is water! She loves splashing around and playing in it, making her the perfect companion for anyone who enjoys outdoor activities near water. Lillie gets along well with dogs of all sizes, so she’d be a great addition to any dog-loving family. She’s also met a cat and wasn’t too interested, so she could potentially live with a cat in the right environment. If you’re looking for a calm, loving, and water-loving companion, Lillie might just be your perfect match!

NAME: Kenny
TEXT: Meet Kenny! Kenny is the happiest dog you will ever meet! Kenny is a friendly, joyful pup who loves everyone he meets. He’s great with all dogs, making him the perfect companion for a multi-dog household. Whether it’s playing or just hanging out, Kenny gets along with dogs of all sizes. Kenny could also live with the right cat! He’s got a gentle and adaptable personality, so he may fit well into a home with a cat that’s comfortable around dogs. If you’re looking for a loving, happy dog to brighten your life, Kenny is your guy!

NAME: Wally
TEXT: Wally is the happiest boy you’ll ever meet! This energetic and playful greyhound loves to keep busy and is always up for a good time. He’s great with small dogs and enjoys playing with toys—he never turns down a game! Wally is also cat-workable, meaning he can get along with cats in the right environment. His friendly, joyful nature makes him a wonderful companion for anyone looking for a fun-loving and energetic dog. Ready to give Wally the loving home he deserves? He’s waiting for you!

NAME: Willow
TEXT: I'm attending the ACT Adoption Day on March 22nd! - Greyhound Adoption Event Canberra This is Willow! A sweet natured, playful and engaging girl, after her forever home. She is incredibly social, loves to follow you like a shadow and has great lead manners. For her age, Willow is either being lazy curled up sleeping or running around with her friends.

NAME: Enzo
TEXT: Enzo is the perfect blend of calm, playful, goofy and loving. He enjoy spending time in the office and although he tolerates the chaos of the office, he ideally would prefer a calm and quiet lifestyle. He doesn't mind if he lives in a house or a unit, as long as he has a good daily routine, showing off his cheerful and adaptable nature. A neighbourhood out of the city or hustle and bustle would best suit Enzo. Some things to know about Enzo... He is known to pick up his ball and throw it at you! He likes a crate, too. He's also learnt that small dogs and greyhounds are friends! This adorable boy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Debra
TEXT: Meet Debra, the hilarious and playful girl who will keep you smiling all day long! Debra loves to bounce around and show off her excitable personality, often offering a fun play bow! She is highly people social and always eager to be near her humans, and enjoy snuggling right up to you when on the couch. Debra's also a big fan of meeting new people - she’ll be the first to trot up to strangers for some pats! Thanks to her strong food drive, Debra is an absolute dream when it comes to training. She has excellent name recall, responds well to commands like "on your bed" "off" "down" and "shake". When it comes to walks, Debra is a pro on the lead and this adventurous girl would do well in a quieter dog populated neighbourhood to make her walks breezy and enjoyable! Debra would thrive in a home with kids who have experience with bigger dogs and can appreciate her bouncy nature. She could also adapt well to a household with full-time workers and is apartment-friendly - Making her a great fit to many kinds of homes! Debra has shown to get along well with other medium to large dogs, meaning she could be a great fit for a family looking to add to their furry companions. This adorable and well rounded girl is available now at our Western Sydney location!

NAME: Summer
TEXT: The sun is shining - Summer is finally here! Well, Summer the greyhound that is! Summer is affectionate yet independent. She doesn’t mind spending time alone, making her a great fit for a variety of lifestyles. She has also spent time around children aged 3+ making her a great fit for families. Summer is a super social and friendly girl, making her perfect for those wanting an affectionate companion. She absolutely loves people, enjoys playtime, and settles beautifully inside. Summer is learning about the world and other dogs here at the centre and is doing so well! She would benefit from ongoing training for her dog sociability but is doing well at the centre. With the right family, Summer will thrive and make a wonderful companion. So grab your hat and sunnies and get ready to enjoy this ray of sunshine, available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: How cute is Ryan? His smile and his puppy eyes are sure to win you over. Ryan could suit many home types. Keep reading to find out why we love him. Ryan would suit a full time working family, with backyard access, preferably in a quieter neck of the woods. This sweet goofball would suit dog savvy kids, as he can be a bit goofy sometimes! But he does calm down. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan has conquered the Richmond main drag (pictured!). He is ideally looking for a family who have a relaxed lifestyle. Did we mention he's super smart, too? He knows 'on your bed' down & shake – he loves training so an owner who likes to engage in training would be a perfect match! Ryan is waiting here for you at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jordan
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jordan, a gentle, sweet, friendly and quiet natured hound looking for a home to call my own. I'm a chilled out guy who's pretty much always laying on my bed, even when there's lots going on, I am content to watch the world go by. I would enjoy a home with another medium-large canine companion, I've even done well meeting those "small breed dogs" my GAP handlers talk about. I am friendly with those too, but bigger breeds make a bit more sense to me! I dont mind a small yard to call my own, enjoying the indoors and outdoors equally. I would definitely suit a laid-back home, all about that chill lifestyle. Let's take it easy, and enjoy life in the slow lane together. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Oakley is an energetic and fun loving greyhound, he thrives when given structured activities. His ideal owner will love all of his drive, energy and passion for all things fun. His best fit would be an owner who is eager to actively train and work with him. He is a driven hound driven who loves physical and mental stimulation. His perfect match will be someone looking for a highly trainable and driven dog who enjoys training as much as he does. He has a strong need for physical and mental stimulation. His recall is excellent, he performs 'down' on cue, and he has the ability to walk nicely in heel position after exercise. He loves the outdoors and would do best as an outside dog. He is available now from our Western Sydney centre.

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: Meet Lilly – A Sweet and Shy Greyhound! Lilly is a gentle and quiet female greyhound who may be a little shy at first, but once she gets to know you, her affectionate nature shines through. She’s great with all other dogs and would be sutiable for a home with a cat if you are patient and give her time to settle, making her an easy-going companion for any household. Lilly’s calm demeanor and low-key attitude make her the perfect choice for anyone looking for a laid-back, loving pet. Give her time to settle in, and she’ll reward you with endless loyalty and love!

NAME: Domina
TEXT: Hi, I'm Domina, a pretty, gentle natured blue girl looking for a loving home. I can be nervous with new places and people, however I promise to show you my playful and engaged personality once I get to know you. I've shown my GAP handlers how well I do once I trust you, and I promise to be a loyal companion for years to come. I like being around other greyhounds but I think the best home for me is without any other dogs, unless you can create a safe zone for me to get away when I need. I'd love a quiet and nurturing home where my family is more or less around all the time. I'd like a house with a yard or some space to call my own, maybe you have a house with a backyard for me to spend time in?
