TEXT: Hey, I’m Blue! A lovable greyhound with a heart as big as my long legs. If you’re looking for a dog who adores butt scratches, enjoys good company, and knows how to chill, I might just be your perfect match. I get along great with other dogs and don’t mind spending time in the yard while you’re out – but I do love having the freedom to go in and out as I please. I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and take in the fresh air throughout the day. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. When I first started walking, I wasn’t sure what to do, but with some patience and encouragement, I’ve learned to keep going and haven’t had any issues in a long time! Now, I just take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in, - but I thrive best in a home where I still get plenty of interaction throughout the day. I love being around my people and enjoy a good balance of companionship and independence. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. So, if you’re hoping for blue sky forecasts for the rest of your life! Come and meet Blue, its sure to cure your blues!

NAME: Zali
TEXT: Zali is a super sweet, super soft & kind little lady. Zali is a very small female greyhound who would love to find the perfect family. She will benefit from a quieter home, perhaps with another canine pal. She has grown up around young teenage children who adore her. Zali can be a little shy at first but with encouragement, will bring you a toy to play with :)

NAME: Joy
TEXT: Let us introduce JOY! and what a Joy she is! Joy brings out the best in us all. She is full of happiness, kindness & love. Joy is a senior lady but in no way does that slow her down. She is confident, engaging & playful. She loves to explore & is eager to learn. Joy has grown up with smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks & sheep around. If you're searching for two lovely ladies to join your family, Joy's sister Boss, is also available :)

NAME: Boss
TEXT: Miss Boss! Isn't she just a beautiful girl! So happy, care-free & loving. She is affectionate, engaging & patient. Waiting with those big, gorgeous eyes for many many cuddles & kisses. She is an older lady but has a heart full of youth & passion. She will thrive in her new home. Boss has exposure to many different animals, various small breeds, chickens, ducks and sheep. If you're looking for two lovelies to join your home, Boss's sister Joy, is also available :)

NAME: Vixen
TEXT: Meet Vixen, a spunky and joyful girl who’s ready to find her forever home! With her excitable energy and sweet cuddly nature, Vixen is the type of dog who’ll brighten anyone's day! While she’s got a ton of enthusiasm and excitement to share with her people, she’d be happiest as your one and only pup — so she can enjoy having all the attention to herself! Given the time and patience to adjust to her new routine, Vixen will quickly learn how to be the best companion and show you what an amazing pet she can be! If you’re looking for a loving & gentle girl with lots of personality and a zest for life, Vixen just might be your perfect match.

NAME: Sandy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Weighing in at just 25 kg this teeny tiny girl makes up for her size with her adorable personality! Sweet, happy, confident little girl Sandy would be happy with many home types. She is a confident lady who walks super nicely on the lead. She likes treats and will definitely persuade you with her puppy dog eyes. She has spent time living with other greyhounds before and would suit a multi-dog household. Playful and loving, she absolutely loves people and has never met someone she didn't like - making her suitable for a busy social life or a family with kids. She is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Crumpet
TEXT: **I'm in a foster care home in a unit apartment in the inner west of Sydney - reach out to GAP for updates!** Hi everyone, I’m as sweet as a honey drizzled crumpet, and ready to accompany you through your your future brunches and breakfasts. I think I’ll definitely be the sweetest part of your day. I like to be patted and get cuddles. I’m gentle, affectionate, cuddly, and kind to everyone I meet. I have been a polite lady with other greyhound friends & small dogs in our backyard at the centre. I am also learning what these so called "cats" are - stay tuned for updates! Once I settle in, I think I could cope with longer hours alone as I settle well inside. I really enjoy being indoors, so where ever you live - an apartment or house, that's no problem with me as I live in a foster care home in a unit. Full time hours with a dog pal would also suit me just fine! No wonder I'm named after something so sweet, huh! I’m available to adopt from our Western Sydney adoption centre, apply below to meet me and my foster family.

NAME: Conrad
TEXT: **Conrad is currently in a foster home - reach out to the team to meet him!** Conrad is a quiet natured, reserved yet affectionate boy. He is polite meeting other big or small dogs when out and about but would suit a home willing to take things slow while he learns about the world around him. He could happily co exist with another doggie with a similar gentle temperament. He can be a nervous hound when he’s in a new environment and would suit a home with children who are quiet and respectful as he learns to gain his confidence. Conrad is enjoying foster care and can't wait to show you all his new pet skills! Conrad is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Conrad is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Woody
TEXT: Woody is looking for a home with a canine companion or someone home all the time. He has lived in foster care with 2 other hounds and can be left for full time hours with a doggie pal. --- My foster carers call me smoochy, cuddly, quirky, smart & obedient. I love people, I'm so excited for everyone to pat me! My foster carers tell me I'm a special "blue fawn" colour which is apparently quite rare! My foster family go away for full time work & I'm totally blasé about it with my 2 doggie pals next to me. I'm a lazy bones but happy for a daily stroll where I promise to walk perfectly on the lead. I'm ready to share my multi-dog home life experience, tried and tested pet skills & affectionate nature with you! Come meet Woody today and discover the love that only a senior greyhound can offer. **Woody is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info** *Woody has spent months in foster care with 2 greyhound buddies, one male one female - contact the Western Sydney team to meet him*

NAME: Friday
TEXT: Thank God It's Friday! Friday is super affectionate, apartment suitable, who loves his food & cuddles. Friday has a bright and bubbly personality which we all adore here at the centre. Friday would suit a home with stair access. He enjoys being indoors, sunbaking with a mix of couch naps. Friday shows nice calm behaviours with a mix of playful and silly, making him a perfect addition to many home types. Respectful children would enjoy his gentle energy. He could live with another greyhound, too. Come and meet Friday at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Arthur
TEXT: Relaxed & easy going guy. Very easy on lead. This gentle guy has grown up around young children. Gets on well with large breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle preferred, however, I do love my fluffy toys to play around with.

NAME: Harley
TEXT: Meet Harley, a cheerful and easygoing companion. This friendly fella has a personality that's as warm as the summer sun, making him an ideal addition to any family seeking a loyal, loving dog. Harley has a delightful, laid-back nature about him. He is effortlessly sociable, having met small dogs with a friendly yet disinterested attitude, ready to just hang out and enjoy their company without demanding constant interaction. With his infectious happiness and calm, affectionate personality, Harley promises to be a wonderful companion for anyone seeking a peaceful, friendly presence in their life. If you’re ready to welcome an easygoing and friendly buddy into your life, Harley is more than ready to meet you.

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Introducing Bernie, the quintessential chilled canine companion you’ve been looking for! Bernie is the definition of easygoing, and his laid-back demeanor makes him the perfect partner. Bernie's love for food is one of his many endearing traits, and achieving his heart is as simple as offering him his favorite treats. He appreciates the simple things in life and is the type of dog who finds joy in the everyday routine. Whether you’re spending a quiet evening at home or heading out for a casual walk, Bernie is content to be by your side. If you have a penchant for relaxing days and are seeking a loyal, food-motivated friend who's happy and enjoyable to be around, Bernie could be your perfect match.

NAME: Johnny
TEXT: Meet Johnny, a quiet and friendly companion who's ready to fill your home with love and warmth. Johnnie's easygoing nature ensures that he'll easily fit into your daily routine without much fuss. Johnny gets along well with other dogs, and his amiable attitude makes him a great candidate for multi-pet households. He's particularly suited for a laid-back lifestyle, where he can enjoy peaceful moments by your side or spend time playing friends. Whether it's a leisurely walk around the neighborhood or relaxing at home Johnny is keen to be involved Johnny is the perfect fit for a family or individual seeking a loyal and tranquil companion.

NAME: Alice
TEXT: Say hello to Alice, a cheerful and friendly canine companion whose sunny disposition will warm your heart! Her enthusiasm and easygoing nature make every day feel like an adventure. She gets along wonderfully with small dogs, and her friendly attitude extends to cats as well—she's met them and remained perfectly composed. So with the right cat Alice will fit in perfectly. Adopt Alice and watch as every day becomes brighter with her delightful smile and warm, inviting personality.

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Relaxed & very loving older lady. Has spent time around grandchiildren. Storm is a confident girl looking for a life of leisure. She will do well on her own, with full time workers..... or if you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful ladies into your life, Storm’s sister, Chucky is also available :)

NAME: Turbo (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Turbo! This sweet boy is ready to race into your heart. He could live with a calm canine friend in his forever home - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Londonderry centre. Turbo is the perfect combination of playful energy and loving companionship, who is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. While he’s eager to be loved, Turbo will need some time to settle into his new home and access to a backyard or small outdoor space where he can stretch his legs and avoid any accidents, would suit him best. Give this playful & happy boy a chance, and you'll gain a friend for life. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Casey
TEXT: Meet Casey, a gentle and quiet presence looking for a loving new family to call her own. This sweet-natured girl might be a bit shy at first, but once she gets to know you, her affectionate spirit shines through. Casey is good with all dogs and children. Her adaptable temperament and polite demeanor make her an ideal addition to any family. Her experience with young ones means she's great with kids, and her patience and gentle nature ensure a seamless fit into a family atmosphere. While she thrives in quieter settings where she can relax and take her time adjusting, Casey will enthusiastically come out of her shell once she feels comfortable. If you're looking for a devoted, mild-mannered, and sweet-hearted canine companion, look no further than Casey. Her loving disposition and peaceful spirit make her the kind of dog who can turn a house into a warm, welcoming home.

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Rambo is enjoying living in a foster home in inner Sydney. In just a few weeks Rambo has come out of his shell and shown himself to be an affectionate, playful, curious and silly boy. His favourite hobbies include napping on the floor, asking for cuddles (and cheese), and of course exploring the neighbourhood on his daily walks. Well-suited for apartment living, Rambo now has his ‘stairs license’ and can confidently climb several floors. Rambo has a lot of love to give, and would therefore thrive in a calm environment. While he’s very obedient and respectful, Rambo is still working on his skills of independence and improving his confidence when being left alone for longer periods of time. He would enjoy a home with a laid back type of life. Known to roach and chill out, Rambo would be an amazing addition for a laid back couple with some hours alone, retirees due to his gentle nature, or a work from home lifestyle, as long as he gets a couple of short toilet walks around the block. He is well versed in being an apartment hound, but of course he would love a backyard if you had one too! Rambo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Rambo is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Lily
TEXT: Lily has a super sweet and affectionate personality. She is confident meeting new people and will make sure you make lots of friends when you are strutting around town with Lily trotting by your side! She is highly affectionate & will jump up and cuddle into her humans, loves to lean in for more pats and definitely knows the word "cuddles". Lily doesn't mind a few hours alone per day, providing she has access to yard or courtyard type environment. Lily has shown polite manners with other greys, so a home with a medium-larger canine companion would be ok with her. A home with respectful children would be more than ok with him as she has plenty of energy to share the love amongst the whole family. She can’t wait to find her forever home! She is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: Bindi is an adorable little girl with a sweet little personality. She is a friendly bundle of love, who has been socialised around children, other dogs and some exposure to family life, helping her step paws into your new world effortlessly! Bindi would enjoy a home with another medium to large hound and a courtyard/backyard to practise those daily zoomies we all know and love. Her entertaining personality would suit respectful children! Bindi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Terry
TEXT: Are you looking for a gorgeous young boy to join your family? Terry has been learning about the big wide world and can't wait to show you his pet skills! He has been socialised with staffy and kids, and socialised in backyard and home environments. He will quietly approach strangers and happily receive pats, showing off his resilient and quiet nature. We think a home with a courtyard or backyard would suit Terry perfectly as he grows up along side his new family. As he has been socialised with dogs and children, he would make a wonderful family pet for a home with dogs or children. Terry is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: Rose will flourish and bloom in a quiet home. Rose would like to grow her roots strong in a backyard or courtyard setting where she can enjoy the breeze and sunshine. She is partial to a crate but not a requirement for her forever home. She's a calm and gentle little petal who is a bit reserved once in the big wide world but is showing to cope well in new situations here! Rose really shines with other dogs around, so a home where she could be picked to join a doggie crew would suit her wonderfully! Rose is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jack (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Introducing Jack, a gentle hound with a personality as charming as his name. He’s affectionate and playful, and there's nothing he loves more than being an affectionate, curious little guy, sure to win your heart. Jack loves riding in the car, not only that but we've noticed he is gentle and follows direction nicely, showing his ability to learn. He socialises well with kids and could go home with respectful children. All the perfect elements of a wonderful family pet! Offering both companionship and entertainment, Jack is just waiting for someone like you. This is a call to all those who have a love of car rides, and the wonderful curiosities of life; Jack is ready to be your partner in discovery. Let the adventure begin! Jack is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rissole
TEXT: Rissole is a handsome blue boy. Described as a happy, cheerful bubbly boy, we think he could live with older kids and would be content with a courtyard or backyard to call his own. He can be shy when you first get to know him, so a home who enjoy bringing a dog out of their shell will be the best fit for this pretty boy. We have noticed he is more confident around other hounds, and would suit a home with another doggie pal, but not a requirement. He is looking for a quiet loving home - could it be you? Rissole is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cath
TEXT: Hi, I’m Cath, I’m a sweet and affectionate young lady looking for a family who will love me forever. I am such a delightful, charming little girl with an affectionate, quiet nature. I would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to enjoy indoor/outdoor living. I am full of love and life, but the perfect blend of playful and calm, making me a perfect addition to a home looking for a loving companion. I am a little bit shy but I am an 'eager to please' kinda girl who loves treats - making me easy to train in your home. Like all greyhounds, I do have a little burst of energy and will zoom around and play with my toys, but don’t worry as soon as I’m finished you will find me in bed or laying in the sun. If you think this I could be suited to your home then apply to meet me today at our Londonderry site.

NAME: Maxie
TEXT: Gentle boy Maxie is a friendly and affectionate boy who is gentle on the lead, confidently learning about the world around him. Maxie's best home? He says he would love a courtyard, or backyard to enjoy. He could enjoy his new home with another greyhound pal but not a necessity for this cute lad! Maxie's love of treats will help him become the perfect pet for you. He has been sniffing out the perfect home, and he thinks it could be you! If his puppy dog eyes haven't sucked you in, just come on down to meet him! Maxie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Mary
TEXT: Truly the Queen of hearts, your Royal Highness Queen Mary requires a new palace in which to rest her crown. Mary will have you charmed from day one. She would love a home where someone will be home more often than not; someone who works part time would be ideal. Mary is also polite and social - having been experienced with kids ranging from 6 years old and up. If Mary had to share her palace, she wouldn’t mind sharing it with another large canine companion but it is not a necessity. If you believe your Majesty Mary will suit your palace, she is currently at our Londonderry facility ready and waiting for adoption (and the red carpet to be rolled out).

NAME: Anna
TEXT: Anna is a hound that would suit people with an active lifestyle. She would be ready for an adventure, she is great company and she does enjoy downtime also. She is vibrant and very friendly, she is good company.

NAME: Hero
TEXT: Gentle and unbothered, yep Hero is a total catch! Read on for more details... this boy will just melt your heart! Hero is great indoors and could suit apartment living, settling for many hours on his own once he settles in to our office. This gorgeous old man would benefit from a nice relaxed life, life in the slow lane please! He has made good progress at the adoption centre, adjusting to the daily training activities like a champ! He is a friendly boy who enjoys human company and will boop you gently for attention and rub his face on you for some more pats - please - winning over the hearts of everyone at the centre. He walks beautifully on a loose leash with a nice, slow pace. His gentle nature extends to his friendliness with other greyhounds, too, making him a stunning companion for a likeminded, laid back greyhound. Hero is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Yep, Astro is astronomically cute! This gorgeous boy is looking for a quiet backyard, with or without a dog, he's even friendly with small dogs! What a polite and lovely boy....read on to learn more! This sweet boy is currently learning our stairs, to gain his stair licence, one step at a time. He is best suited for shorter hours with or without a doggie pal while he learns to settle in. He's also learning to be friends with cats - watch this space! A backyard with indoor outdoor access and a quiet home who can nurture Astro into the best pet will be the best match for him. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Buzz
TEXT: **I'm currently in a foster home, a unit apartment in the city - Reach out to GAP for more info!* Foster Care Update! "We’ve been able to leave Buzz alone at home while we’ve been out for a few hours without any dramas. He continues to be a very people-loving dog who charms everyone he meets on his walks and loves attention." "He is very confident with people, he is very sweet and affectionate and loves greeting new people (and they love him). From the start he was always coming up to us for pets and cuddles. He has been very good at learning how to go down the steps slowly and carefully. He has been very good when we leave the house. And he doesn’t cry at night either, he’s perfectly happy in his bed until we come out to take him on his morning walk. He loves walking, but he can only walk for 10-15 minutes or less before becoming quite tired due to the extra exertion of walking on three legs. Which makes him a very low maintenance dog! He really only needs a short morning and evening walk/toilet break, maybe some exercise in the backyard at lunch (he loves playing fetch with his soft toys). Otherwise he’s very happy to snooze the day away. Another great thing is that he loves his food but has no interest in human food - Buzz is perfectly happy lying down next to us when we eat. He’s very well toilet trained, no accidents inside." ------ While I am incredibly confident with being out and about and using stairs, a ground floor home is best. I also love small children, however also love licking faces and can have a bit of energy, so older children are preferable to share my home with. I am also A-M-A-Z-I-N-G with training! I know “bed”, my name, “down” and my recall is un-bee-lievable. I would love to bee friends with other dogs of a medium/large size and would happily share my hive with them. So don’t bee a stranger, make a bee-line to the Western Sydney Adoption Centre to meet me today!

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home - reach out to the team to meet me!* Foster Update - "What a lovely natured pup! He's settled in really well. Loves to play with his toys and loves sitting at the window watching everything that goes on in the neighbourhood. We all love Lenny!" Hi, I'm Lenny. Western Sydney's newest senior heart throb! I will happily greet any person and lean into you! I am great indoors with no toileting accidents. I actually prefer being indoors and suit apartment living. I like other greyhounds and happy to live with one but I don't need one in my forever home. I seem to do well on my own, enjoying the independence and time to ponder, and could suit longer hours alone with some practice. I don't mind a crate but it's not essential in my forever home. If you've got a comfortable couch for an adorable wise old man like me, please apply! PS...I cross my legs politely when I lie down. I consider myself quite the fancy boy! I'm a super special lad, please meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Midnight
TEXT: Midnight has socialised with children 1 year old and up, making him a wonderful addition to a growing family looking for a beloved family member. He loves a beanbag and a couch, and is a friendly boy with new people and places. He would love to learn about pet life with you slowly as he has not yet learnt everything there is to know. He would make a great addition to a home with another dog, and is learning to be friendly with small dogs and cats! Very happy, playful yet calm, Midnight is a perfect blend of everything you want in a greyhound. Midnight is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Honey
TEXT: Honey is the sweetest little girl (24kg) with personality plus! She has been living in a family home, housetrained and gets along with other greys, a pug, poodle, fox terrier and staffy! She ignored the household cat. She especially loves sleeping on the 10-year-old daughter's bed, otherwise on her own bed. Honey still has bursts of energy & a run around morning and night. She also loves car trips and walks (needs a bit of lead practice), not a fan of water and is a toilet paper fiend (close bathroom doors)! Also loves her food so feed separately from other dogs and cats. She is a gorgeous girl for most households, preferably with someone around or a dog friend, loves to be inside and part of household life. 😍

NAME: Arthur
TEXT: And I say HEY! What a wonderful kind of day. If you can learn to work and play and get along with Arthur the greyhound! Arthur is a total cutie pie. He is the star of the show, much like the 90's show! Arthur would enjoy a home without another canine companion, and would prefer his family members to be older children or adults only. He is super polite with other hounds but doesn't need their companionship, so being a solo pet is best for this independent boy. He is a shy boy at heart, but loves smooches and cuddles once you get to know him. A backyard or courtyard would be preferred while he learns the ins and outs of pet life. He can even do stairs, walking on a loose lead, as well as learning some training cues like 'on your bed' and 'off your bed'... Talk about talented! It's a simple message and it comes from the heart, Believe in this (and in Arthur the greyhound) for that's the place to start! Arthur is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Nacho
TEXT: Taco bout cute! We don't want to make it too cheesy, but in between napping and playtime, we think Nacho's got what it takes to salsa into your life like he's always been there. He doesn't mind if you go out for a few hours, making him suitable for those who are out of the house for long periods, as long as he has backyard access. Nacho’s perfect home is one where he gets daily playtime and enrichment as he does enjoy having fun! Opaque fencing in his backyard will help him thrive! He would also love to spend his days with another greyhound or M-L doggie friend. He is affectionate, friendly and snuggly too. He's learnt a bunch of tricks at the centre like how to do stairs, learning to do 'down' and even shake! Older kids with dog experience would be a great match. He’s looking for a family who can appreciate a dog with a zest for life (and cheesy puns...) Nacho is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. All you have to do is bring the love (and maybe some chips).

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet the one and only Missy. An absolute delight in all aspects of her being, she is extremely playful and still has puppy tendencies, which is why we have said she would suit older children as she doesn't quite know her size. Missy loves to engage for pats and throwing a toy for her but would like to have time to herself and have it respected in her new home. Due to Missy's age she may find adjusting to a new home a little bit hard but she has the confidence to grow and develop if her new parents are interested.

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith – a sweet, friendly, and gentle boy who's looking for his forever home! He's tiny in size for a male, weighing in the same as our smaller girls! He is an affectionate and cuddly guy who loves his treats and is quick to pick up new things, making him a dream to train! He has already mastered many essential pet skills including laying down on cue, getting off the bed/couch when told, shake and 'leave it'! Keith also does really well with our other greyhounds on site, and would likely thrive in a home where he has a medium/large sized furry friend by his side. As a single dog, this adorable boy would do best in a household where someone is around more often at first to help him settle in. But, if his new home has another doggie pal to keep Keith company he probably wouldn't mind too much if his people are gone during the day! He’s been on his best behaviour while spending time inside, but would still like to have access to a backyard or courtyard while he gets used to his new home. If you’re looking for a loving and affectionate dog, Keith could be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Cookie
TEXT: Cookie is a friendly & social girl looking for her new home where she will be surrounded by love and attention! She’s very human-focused and loves being around people, always displaying positive consent and gentle affection. Whether it’s playtime or cuddle time, she’s sure to brighten your day! Cookie does very well walking calmly on a lead, making walks a relaxed and enjoyable experience. She’s also shown to be good around our other greyhounds, and could be happy sharing her new home with another medium/large doggie friend - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Western Sydney site. Contact us today to learn more about this lovely girl and discuss booking in an appointment to meet her!

NAME: Wynstan
TEXT: Wynstan with a Y here...let me tell you a bit about myself! I hope you like a happy affectionate boy, if so, read on! I love to lean on my handlers and show off my adorable affectionate nature. Did anyone tell you I'm also polite with big and small dogs? Seriously, I'm a catch! I'm also all about my treats, so if you're looking to teach me tricks, please involve snacks too! This will help me settle in and learn how to be the best pet for you. Everyone says I'm amazing, so I guess they love how I walk so nicely and gently on the lead for walkies, too! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre, see you soon!

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Hi I'm Millie! I'm a friendly, happy girl who loves to greet you with a big smile. I'm an affectionate girl who promises to walk nicely on the lead for our daily adventures, making me a great fit for families or couples looking for an adventure buddy. I don't mind if you have respectful children or other larger breed dogs at home, as I've shown I'm a friend to greyhounds here. I'm ideally looking for a home with a bit of a townhouse or backyard, but I promise to be by your side for snuggles at night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Matey
TEXT: Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and happy go lucky energy, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! Matey has spent some time in a foster care home and we have learnt he loves spending time with his family and going for a quiet sniffari around the block! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a playful companion and would do best in a home without young kids or other pets. Matey suits part-time or full-time workers provided he lives in a quiet area with opaque fencing so he can just relax and snooze the day away in the backyard. Get ready to meet your new best Matey! This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Paul is a stunning boy who is great to play with, can be left alone. He is social and confident with other dogs and a good walker on the lead.

NAME: Andy
TEXT: Andy is a lovely boy, he is very confident and obedient. Knows his name and is good to walk on the lead. Has had exposure to various native animals living in a rural area.

NAME: Flint
TEXT: Flint is a polite gentleman when it comes to people & other dogs. He would suit a calm canine friend in his forever home. He’s all about manners and will leave you impressed with how well he interacts with both humans and other greyhounds. Flint is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. While he’d love to be an inside dog, indoor outdoor access to a backyard or small outdoor space (eg courtyard) where he can stretch his legs and avoid any accidents, would suit him best. Flint is a polite young man who can't wait to meet you. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Faye
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home in Sydney - reach out to the team to meet me!* This adorable and gentle girl is looking for fun loving home to call her own! Faye is an adorable girl who is friendly with people she meets. Maybe you're retired, work from home or live a chilled life, as she prefers someone around more often than not. Faye wouldn't mind living in a unit apartment & she would enjoy a home where she is going to be a beloved family member. Faye would suit a home with another likeminded greyhound or respectful children. Sweet little Faye is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is currently in a foster home with his sister Katie. We have loved getting to know Ace and giving him the opportunity to enjoy his new life as a pet. Affectionally known to us as our ‘Sookie Lala’, Ace just wants to be by your side 24/7. He loves being close and seeing what things you are getting up to throughout your day. He also loves the outdoor (and indoor) couch and will happily settle in there for the day when outside. Ace will bounce happily on his toes when we come home and loves a hug and cuddle. We are teaching him how to play fetch and he really enjoys being included in any play time activities. He is toilet trained and sleeps very well throughout the night. Ace walks wonderfully on a leash as he likes to be right by your side. He doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small and is very friendly to other small dogs and children. If you have love to give and are looking for a dog to soak it all in – Ace is your boy! ______________________________________________________________________________ Ace is a playful and gentle hound. He was very friendly and nice when he met my daughter and was good company with a good balance of being playful and affectionate. Gets along great with other greyhounds. Currently fostered in a suburban home and getting comfy coming inside the house and loving the backyard.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is currently in a foster home with her brother Ace. We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Toby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Toby is in a foster care home with a female greyhound and a male Jack Russell - reach out to the team to organise a meet and greet** Update from foster: "Like all dogs, he needs & loves his routine. Toby is sometimes playful & sometimes he plays with the smaller dog. He definitely needs another dog as his mate, he can be left alone for up to 2 hours with his doggie pal while indoors, but can be left alone all day outdoors with a doggie pal. He needs a reasonably calm, reassuring environment. Loves his walks, and is very good on the leash. (A bit of a sticky beak, so sometimes you have to let him stop and observe for a bit.) Is totally at ease with other dogs and people he has met. He is very observant and "switched on'. Toby is a very social dog, both with other dogs and people. We've never had an issue with him toileting inside. He sleeps right through the night. Toby is better suited to a forever home with regular companionship, whether it be a human or another doggie pal. Once settled in his forever home, Toby will lie on his mat and sleep/relax for quite some time. Toby loves being with you, but is happy to observe or go off investigate/lie down and relax, keeping out of your way. Toby also loves to go on car rides and ad ventures making travelling a breeze." If Toby sounds like the adorable, loveable boy you have been searching for contact GAP today! **Toby is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Flash
TEXT: **I'm in a foster home** Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Alex
TEXT: Meet Alex, an incredibly fun and playful greyhound with a heart full of energy and charisma! He loves playing games with toys and is always up for a good fetch session. Alex would thrive in a home with a spacious backyard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. He’s especially fond of older kids who can keep up with his playful nature. If you're looking for a joyful, active companion, Alex might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Derick
TEXT: Derick is a handsome and lively 5 year-old greyhound with striking colouring inspired by the Tasmanian devil. He’s a playful and affectionate boy who adores attention and thrives on human companionship. While he gets excited during playtime and when he sees his lead—often jumping with joy—he quickly settles down and walks beautifully on a lead. Derick has been socialised around other greyhounds, and would make a fun and loving addition to an active person looking for a loyal companion.

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Are you looking for a calm, mega chill, laid back boy to join your world? Maybe you've seen those amazing pet greyhounds out on walkies in the big wide world and thought you'd like your very own amazing boy? Well I'm laid back, confident, walk well with my head held high! I'm ready to meet you and show you how amazing I am! I'm relaxed, quiet, gentle, and laid back. I'm super friendly with other dogs including small dogs. I could totally suit a home with respectful children as I am a total love bug. I am available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rose Maree
TEXT: Meet Rose Maree, a truly gorgeous and sweet canine companion ready to steal your heart. Rose Maree enjoys the simple pleasures in life, like lazing in the shade on a sunny day, where she can unwind and watch the world around her. Playtime is something Rose Maree cherishes, and toys are her absolute favourite. This lovely girl thrives on fun and interaction, especially when playing with kids. Her playful energy shines through when she's chasing a ball keeping young ones entertained for hours. . Rose Maree's ideal home is one where she can bask in sunshine and have access to plenty of toys and loving playmates. She loves spending time with her family and taking in the blissful outdoors. If you're looking for a playful companion to add warmth and joy to your family, Rose Maree is ready to join you on a sun-dappled adventure!

NAME: Tree
TEXT: Looking for a dog who’s part rocket, part couch potato, and 100% lovable? Say hello to Tree, a 2.5-year-old Greyhound who’s ready to plant his roots in your heart (and maybe your lap). Tree is a certified people-person in dog form- he thrives on attention, affection, and the occasional belly rub. If you’re home more often than not, Tree will be your shadow, your cuddle buddy, and your biggest fan. He’s got great recall and walks like a dream on the leash, so he’s always up for a stroll, as long as it’s by your side. Playful and full of life, Tree loves to let loose in a yard – he’s got energy to burn would rather zoom than doom-scroll any day. While he’s a big dog with big love to give, he’s still figuring out that not all small dogs appreciate his enthusiasm. Larger canine companions are more his vibe, so he’d prefer a household where the pint-sized pups don’t steal the show. Bonus points: Tree is stair-savvy, lap-approved, and ready to bring a whole lot of fun into your life. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who’s as happy sprinting as he is snuggling, Tree might be your perfect match.

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Meet sweet & beautiful Chandler... Chandler is a gentle and polite male greyhound with a calm and relaxed demeanor. He’s a sweetheart who greets everyone warmly and enjoys a good snuggle, especially after a sunbath. Chandler has been around older kids and medium-sized dogs, and he gets along well with both. He’s also a joy to walk on a lead, making him the perfect companion for leisurely strolls. Whether lounging in the sun or curled up for some quiet time, Chandler is sure to bring a sense of calm and affection to any home.

NAME: Chino
TEXT: **Chino has just gone into a foster care home - check back for updates!** Order up! One tall and fluffy Chino, brewed to perfection with a dash of sweetness, is ready to find his forever home! Chino is looking for a cozy spot where he can enjoy a laid-back retirement, sipping on the peaceful moments of life. He's got a smooth, mellow, personality, but every now and then, he perks up for a playful burst – just like that shot of espresso when you need it most. His favorite thing? Leaning into you for the ultimate cuddle, because he's all about getting those extra pats! Chino is a friend to dogs of all sizes and would love to share his home with a canine companion. If he's the only pet in your cup of tea, part-time workers are just the right blend for him, but with a doggy friend, he’s content to chill solo for longer hours. Chino’s chill vibe makes him a great fit for families with kids, as long as he’s got his own little nook to unwind in when he needs a break. If you think Chino would be the perfect addition to your family, apply online today – he’s ready to be your new favourite brew!

NAME: Sting
TEXT: Get ready to feel the Sting of love from this handsome boy! With his confident personality and loving nature, Sting is ready to take on the world, whether it’s playing in the backyard or having a cuddle session. Sting would thrive with an owner who can match his energy and provide plenty of love and attention. He would be open to sharing his new home with another furry friend, pending a meet & greet with the GAP team. He also has the potential to work up to longer hours alone, but would like he family or another furry companion with him to help settle in the early stages. If you’re looking to welcome a dog who’s full of personality and ready to make your life even more exciting, Sting might be the one for you!

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Roaring into your heart, one paw at a time! Tiger is ready to bring excitement and joy to your life. While he may need some time to adjust, once he feels at home, Tiger will become your best companion. Scar would love a courtyard or backyard to laze around and have the occasional play in. He could suit a home with another medium/large breed dog if they can respect his more reserved nature. If you're looking for a sweet and affectionate friend, Tiger is waiting to meet you. Can you be the one to give this sweet boy the home he deserves?

NAME: Scar
TEXT: Don’t let his name fool you, Scar is a softie at heart. Though he may take a little time to warm up, once he feels comfortable, Scar’s friendly and affectionate nature will shine through. Scar would thrive in a calm environment with a family who can work with him to learn how to be the best furry companion he could be. Scar is open to sharing his home with another medium/large furry friend - pending a meet & greet at our Londonderry site. With some patience and training he also has potential to be able to be built up to spending longer periods of time alone. If you’re ready to give him the time and care he needs, Scar will reward you with loyalty and love.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Meet Benji, a sweet and excitable boy who’s looking for his perfect forever home! Despite Benji nearing his senior years, he'll still win your heart over with his playful antics and would love a home with a courtyard or backyard to spend his time playing and sunbaking in. Benji has been around children of all ages in his previous home and could do well in a household with experienced children who can appreciate his enthusiastic nature. If you're ready to welcome a loving, loyal friend into your life, Benji can’t wait to meet you and be a part of your family!

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: Banjo is a sweet boy who is very relaxed and comfortable. He does like to play, go for walks and enjoys a swim. He would suit multiple homes since he is so laid back and relaxed.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Jax is a fun young hound who likes to play go for walks and enjoys a good rest afterwards. He lives in a suburban backyard and is conditioned to being left alone during full time work hours. He comes when called and enjoys a walk.

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Rusty, a lovable and energetic boy who is ready to find his forever home! Rusty is a friendly companion who has had a brief introduction to pet life in his previous home - spending some time indoors, being taken on public walks and also meeting new people, including children! His warm, golden fur is as soft as his heart, and he’ll quickly become your new best friend and would do well in a home where he can get plenty of attention, exercise, and affection. If you're looking for a dog who will bring joy to your life, Rusty might be the perfect fit. Come meet him today—he can’t wait to share his love with you!

NAME: Midas
TEXT: Gentle, calm and a lovely walking companion, Midas will add the glitz and gold to your life. Midas is an affectionate and gentle boy, who shines with attention and love. He would prefer his family around more this summer as he settles in, and with further training could be left for longer hours. Everything he touches will turn to gold...he is a friendly and calm boy looking for a family with or without children to love him forever! Midas is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billson
TEXT: Bubbly, effervescent and a perfect accompaniment for your life (not only this summer!), Billson is a sweet and joyful hound. He has been around children of all ages and would suit a home with respectful children. A low small dog population is the best fit for Billson as he needs to learn and have more training around them. Upbeat and fun, Billson would suit many home types. He's an energetic lad with some energy to fizz away, so a home with the family members around more often than not would be the best fit for Billson. Grab a slab and join Billson this summer! He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jimbo
TEXT: Jimbo is a polite, happy and laid back boy best described as chilled out and relaxed. As he is entering his senior years he has a wonderful calm energy. Gorgeous inside and out, this boy is so sweet! He has spent time around other greyhounds, and children, and would suit many home types. He's what greyhound people call a "leaner"! He will lean on you for pats! Jimbo would prefer his family around more often than not while he settles in, and a home with a medium to large doggie friend would see him settle for longer hours. Jimbo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: This adorable boy is the sweetest little guy ever! Teddy is a very friendly and social boy who is calm on the lead, snuggly and friendly with other grey's and even polite with smaller dogs on walkies. Teddy is great with other medium/large sized dogs and would happily join a family who already has one and spend the day with them while his humans are out. As a single dog, Teddy will need someone around more often than not to keep him company. Older, respectful kids are suitable for Teddy and would enjoy his goofy playfulness! So come and cuddle our little Teddy today! He is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Queeny
TEXT: Queeny is a happy, very lovable and friendly young girl who loves life! She would be a great addition for a young couple or family with older kids on her own or with another greyhound or medium to large dog. She just wants to be part of your life, be a sticky beak, play, and have fun! She can also settle down and have a rest when needed, inside or out in a large yard. She has been around a lot of people coming and going in an office environment, noises don't worry her. Queeny loves to wander around the yard and play, then sleep inside with other retired greys during the day or in her own indoor kennel. She is used to walking on lead, loves pats and is well-behaved when given love and attention. She would adore a new home to settle into with her own special people be your loyal companion. 🥰

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy, a stunning female red fawn greyhound with a perfect balance of strength and sweetness. Missy can be strong on the lead, making her walks an exciting experience, but she is also incredibly relaxed and calm, adapting well to new environments and settling into a peaceful routine at home. Missy’s playful side shines through when it’s time for fun! She loves engaging with her humans, whether it’s a lively game or simply hanging out and soaking up attention. Her joyful and affectionate nature makes her a delightful companion for an active family or an individual who enjoys both adventure and relaxation. With her combination of strength, playfulness, and a laid-back attitude, Missy is ready to bring her warmth and energy into a loving home. If you’re looking for a dog who will keep you on your toes while also offering plenty of cuddles, Missy could be your perfect match!

NAME: Ringo
TEXT: Ringo is the handsome fawn boy who is looking for an active person or family to take him on adventures Ringo is fine with fulltime workers and is just excited to go for his daily walk and play. Ringo will sleep and play the day away with some toys or a bone in the backyard whilst you are at work. Ringo has grown up with children as young as 5 years old and loves hanging out with them. Ringo has grown up sharing his yard with his best friends two greyhounds Barber and Penny. Ringo is on the lookout for his perfect match and with some love and care will make the perfect pet

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 6 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Jagger
TEXT: He’s got the moves like Jagger! This boy certainly knows how to impress! Jagger is a special boy with a personality that can melt your heart. Jagger has a laid-back and easy-going nature, making him suited a home that has a secure backyard/courtyard type environment. Jagger can adapt to a household where family members work full-time, as long as he receives the love and attention he deserves when they return home. Providing him with a comfortable space and engaging toys during the day can help keep him content. Due to his sweet nature, he is an ideal choice for a home with respectful children seeking a loving companion. He has shown to be polite with other medium to large canine companions. He is a social boy and enjoys the companion of his four-legged friends, if you have other dogs in the home, he will surely enjoy showing them his moves! Be sure to apply online today and mention Jagger’s name in your application, you don’t want to miss out on welcoming this loving, gentle and playful boy to your home.

NAME: Onyx
TEXT: Hey, I’m Onyx! I’m a fun-loving, playful Greyhound who’s all about adventure—especially when it comes to walkies and toys. I get super excited and might even do a little happy dance when I see the leash! After I’ve burned off some energy, though, I’m totally happy to settle down and be the best snuggle buddy ever. I’m great inside the house—no accidents here—and I promise I’m pretty low-maintenance when it comes to relaxing with you. Now, I do have one little request: I’m a one-pet kinda guy. I really prefer being the center of attention and soaking up all your love. Other pets? Not my thing. I just want to be your one and only, and trust me, I’ll make it worth your while! Oh, and about my voice—I’ve got a special talent. When I bark or howl, it sounds like an ambulance siren! It’s my way of letting you know when I’m excited or when I just want some attention. It’s quirky, and I think you’ll find it pretty hilarious once you hear it. If you’re looking for a goofy, affectionate companion who’ll keep you on your toes with zoomies and then curl up for some quality sleep time, I’m your guy. I can’t wait to find my forever home!

NAME: Disco
TEXT: Discos happy and playful energy makes her the perfect companion for a household ready to spend time playing and getting her walkies in. She will very quickly become your new best friend and would enjoy having people around more often in the early stages of being in her new home. Disco could also do well with another small or big dog friend. This happy girl would thrive in a home with less stimulation, she can live with a unit apartment life or a backyard.

NAME: Costa
TEXT: Meet Cuddle Me Costa, a sweet and affectionate male greyhound who lives up to his name with big, warm cuddles! Costa is a confident, happy boy who loves to shower his family with love. He’s well-socialized with young children and medium-sized dogs, making him a perfect fit for family life. Costa is equally content doing his own thing or hanging out with the family, whether it’s relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet moment outdoors. With his loving nature and laid-back attitude, Costa is sure to bring joy and comfort to your home.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a friendly and easy-going male greyhound who loves socializing with young children and other medium-sized dogs. This laid-back fellow is happy to go with the flow, whether it’s enjoying a quiet moment at home or joining in on family activities. Rocky is a calm and adaptable companion, making him an ideal choice for a family looking for a well-mannered dog who’s great with kids and other pets. His gentle nature and relaxed attitude mean he’s content to simply be part of the family and enjoy whatever life brings his way.

NAME: Jay Jay
TEXT: Say g’day to JayJay this beautiful female has had a wonderful life around children as young as 1 year old and also around Medium dogs. Jayjay is 5 years of age and is a perfect mix between puppy playful during the day and settled mature girl of a night. Jay jay is always excited to go for a walk and would be the perfect dog for someone looking at undertaking adventures and longer walks Jayjay travels well in a car and would love a backyard to play the day away in

NAME: Dave
TEXT: Dave is personality plus & ready to spread joy to all who meet him. He's a goofy boy who is energetic, as well as super sweet and affectionate. He could suit apartment living with someone around all the time - he loves being indoors but still learning to be left alone. Dave requires a quiet/low stimulation home life & someone who can keep him active and mentally fit. Older kids who can handle a goofy large breed dog would suit best. Dave has great food drive and responds well to training. Dave would enjoy a home with canine or human company during the day, and would thrive with living with another bouncy vibrant canine companion.

NAME: Colin
TEXT: Colin is an outgoing boy who loves to go on adventures and would love a daily walk around the neighbourhood. Colin can be a little bit cautious at the very start but settles very quickly and becomes your best friend within minutes. Colin jumps with excitement but settles very quickly Colin loves a car trip and is happy to jump up in to the car before laying down and sleeping the trip away. Colin would love a single person or a young couple who are keen to spend some time teaching him about the adventures of the world and what a lounge feels like to sleep on Colin is ready to give a family lots of love

NAME: Baby
TEXT: Nobody puts baby in the corner! This little lady is looking to learn all about the world with you! She would suit short hours alone as a solo girl, or longer hours with a canine companion. Polite with dogs big or small, beautiful Baby has so much love to give and is searching for the right place to call home. If this Baby girl sounds like the perfect addition to your family, apply to take her home from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a wonderfully sweet nature and a calm temperament. Bear's calm demeanor makes him an ideal partner for leisurely strolls, as he's quite responsive on a lead. Whether you're taking a walk in the park or simply exploring your local neighborhood, Bear's company will surely make your day brighter. His gentle pace and attentive nature are perfect for anyone seeking a serene and steady walking buddy.

NAME: Clyde
TEXT: Meet Clyde, the charming socialite of the dog world! This happy-go-lucky greyhound is always ready to make new friends and engage with anyone he meets. His confidence shines as he approaches life with a tail wag and a friendly demeanor that wins over hearts immediately. Clyde absolutely adores ear scratches, and you’ll find him happily leaning in for more attention whenever he gets the chance. Whether he's meeting new people or hanging out with his greyhound buddies, Clyde is always the life of the party, making sure everyone feels welcome and included.

NAME: Ivanka
TEXT: Meet Ivanka, a playful and excited lady with a heart full of affection! This happy female greyhound is ready to bring joy and energy to your home. Playful and affectionate. Loves to give a classic Greyhound lean and cuddle. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller canine friends. Enjoys active playtime and engaging walks. Thrives in a lively environment where she can express her playful spirit. A loving and active household that can keep up with her playful nature. Suitable for families or individuals who appreciate a happy, energetic companion. If you’re looking for a lively and loving companion, Ivanka would be thrilled to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Moe Joe
TEXT: Meet Joe, an old sweet and gentle boy looking for a quiet, loving home! This charming male greyhound may be a little slow on his feet, but he has a heart full of affection and is ready to bring warmth to your life. Gentle and loving. Loves a gentle touch and affection. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller canine family members. Prefers leisurely strolls and relaxed outings. Enjoys a calm environment where he can feel safe and cherished. A peaceful household that appreciates a slower pace. Ideal for individuals or families who can provide plenty of love and companionship. If you’re looking for a sweet companion to share your home with, Joe would love to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Issac
TEXT: Meet Issac, an old gentle boy with a heart full of love! This sweet male greyhound is looking for a quiet home where he can enjoy leisurely walks and plenty of cuddles. Gentle and affectionate. Loves a good scratch and is always ready for cuddles. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller dogs. Prefers leisurely walks at a relaxed pace. Enjoys a calm environment and appreciates quiet time. A peaceful household, perfect for someone who enjoys a slower lifestyle. Ideal for families or individuals who can provide gentle affection and companionship. If you’re looking for a loving companion to share your home with, Issac would be thrilled to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Zooie
TEXT: Meet Zooie, an older gentleman with a heartwarming, sweet nature. This charming male is looking for a peaceful home where he can enjoy gentle affection and quiet moments.
